summary.zh: 设计指标、日志与链路追踪，收敛告警并搭看板
summary.en: Design metrics, logs and traces, tune alerts and dashboards.

description.zh: 为服务规划 SLI 与 SLO，理清该上报哪些指标、日志和链路追踪，重排噪音告警并生成看板草稿。适合新服务定监控口径，或告警太吵、看板没人看的时候。附带的生成脚本需要 Python 环境运行。
description.en: Defines SLIs and SLOs, decides which metrics, logs and traces to emit, quiets noisy alerts and sketches dashboards. Use it before launching a service or when alerts are too loud to trust. The included scripts run on Python.
